name: Explain physiological mechanisms and nutritional facts
description: Users asked for factual information and physiological explanations regarding normal biological ranges, hormone levels, metabolic processes, and the specific effects of dietary components on the body. The inquiries focused on understanding mechanisms such as fasting, nutrient absorption, and supplement interactions to interpret personal health data or optimize physiological functions.
